title: おせち料理のイラスト
subject_en: Japanese New Year osechi dishes, each a separate item, refined Japanese illustration style with red, gold and black accents Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 重箱のおせち、黒豆、伊達巻、鯛。お正月のお料理を和のタッチで描いた12点。
items: a stacked three-tier red lacquer osechi box, lid beside it, filled with colourful dishes
a small dish of glossy black beans
slices of datemaki rolled omelette with swirl pattern
a whole red sea bream, celebratory
a red curled shrimp on a small plate
red and white kamaboko slices arranged in a row
herring roe pieces on a small plate
golden chestnut paste with a whole chestnut
a lacquer bowl of ozoni with mochi, carrot and greens
a red sake set with a flat cup and a pouring pitcher
two round rice cakes stacked with a mandarin on top
candied small dried sardines on a small plate
